# The Beyond Human Method

> The Beyond Human Method is Tamara Rose's energy clearing methodology, built over 15 years and more than 20,000 hours of guiding people through change. Tamara works with clients online from the Rocky Mountains of Colorado. The method finds the one energetic pattern at the root of a person's money, relationship, body, career and parenting issues and clears it at the root level, so their whole life moves forward at one time. It is for people who have done the work (books, coaching, courses, therapy) and still haven't made the change they want.

Key ideas, as Tamara teaches them:

- If you've done the work and you're still stuck, most likely the gap is in your alignment, not in what you know. Your life organizes itself around the pattern you're aligned in, so more effort only gets you more of the same.
- Everyone's life is running on a primary pattern, and it can be cleared. A common one is "I'm not good enough," which shows up as overproducing to prove your value: working harder for money, doing more to receive love, saying yes to everything as a parent, and success that only comes from more hours.
- Think of yourself as a tree. Most personal growth works on the branches (a business coach, a therapist, a trainer, a money book), but the pattern lives in the root, which is why change in one area rarely holds. When the root pattern clears, relationships, money, business and health shift together.
- The method has three practices: (1) find the root pattern, (2) clear it at the energetic level and create a new reality you love, and (3) energetic alignment mastery, consistently matching your thoughts, feelings and actions to that new reality. The discomfort of the new reality is where the change happens, which is why the program is a full year.
- Five pillars: Clear (release inherited patterns, beliefs and lineage), Align (thoughts, feelings and actions in coherence with the life you want), Create (co-create with universal source energy instead of forcing outcomes), Intuit (hear your intuition and tell it apart from fear) and Trust (let go of control and act on what's true for you). Underneath all five is a new foundation of living: a regulated nervous system, daily practices and rituals.

- [Energetic Alignment Audit](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/audit): everything begins with finding your primary pattern. A private 90-minute session on Zoom that names the pattern, where it came from and what becomes possible when it clears, with the recording, transcript and a written Energetic Blueprint. A $1,500 value; the investment is $497, credited in full toward working with Tamara.

The next cohort begins January 7, 2027.
- Private work for founders and executives, one to one with Tamara. It also begins with the Audit.

## Everyday resets

- [Celebrate Your Small Wins: The Science of Acknowledging Your Achievements](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/acknowledging-your-achievements): Skipping the celebration and racing to the next goal costs you. Here's the science of celebrating small wins and simple ways to acknowledge your progress.
- [The Benefits of a Bath or Shower Before Bed, Plus My Favorite Bath Recipe](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/bath-before-bed): A warm bath or shower 1 to 2 hours before bed helps you fall asleep faster. Here's the science, the timing, and my favorite relaxing bath recipe.
- [Breath Breaks: A Five-Minute Reset for Your Mind and Body](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/breath-break): A breath break is a few minutes of slow, intentional breathing that calms your nervous system. Here's why it works and how to take one, indoors or out.
- [The Benefits of Reading Before Bed Instead of Scrolling](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/evening-reading): Swapping your phone for a printed book at night can help you relax, sleep better and feel more connected. Here's what the research says about evening reading.
- [The Benefits of Grounding for Your Mind, Body and Spirit](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/grounding): Grounding, or earthing, means touching the earth with your bare skin. Here's what research says about its benefits for stress, sleep and inflammation.
- [Screens Before Bed: How Your Phone and TV Affect Your Sleep and Wellbeing](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/how-screens-effect-sleep): Late-night phones and TV delay melatonin, disrupt your sleep and raise stress. Here's what the research shows and how to unplug an hour before bed.
- [How to Create Change in Your Life, and Sustain It](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/how-to-create-change): You want change, so why is it so hard to make it stick? After 15 years of coaching, here's what I've learned about willingness, the gap and lasting change.
- [How Your Thoughts Shape Your Reality, and Why Affirmations Work Best at Night](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/how-your-thoughts-shape-your-reality): Your thoughts and beliefs shape what you create. Here is the science of affirmations, why bedtime makes them stronger, and where they fall short.
- [Morning Journaling: How a Blank Page Can Change Your Day](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/journaling-transforms-your-day): Morning journaling helps you notice your patterns, manage your emotions and set your intentions. Here's why it works, plus 7 morning journal prompts.
- [The Benefits of Making Your Bed Every Morning](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/making-your-bed-every-morning): Making your bed takes two minutes and sets the tone for your whole day. Here's what the research says about the benefits for your mood, stress and sleep.
- [The Benefits of Morning Meditation for Calm, Focus and Presence](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/morning-meditation): A few minutes of meditation in the morning reduces stress, sharpens focus and helps you stay present. Here's the science and an easy way to start.
- [Music for Stress Relief: How Soft Acoustic Music Calms Your Brain](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/music-for-the-mind): Soft acoustic music can ease stress, help you unwind and support better sleep. Here's what the research shows and how to use music to calm your mind.
- [The Benefits of Taking Your Shoes Off in the House](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/no-shoes-in-house): Taking your shoes off at the door keeps what you walk through outside out of your home and signals your body it's time to relax. Here's why it's worth the habit.
- [How to Regulate Your Nervous System When Everything Feels Like Too Much](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/regulating-nervous-system): Feeling overstimulated, wired or burned out? Here's how overstimulation affects your nervous system and six simple practices to help you calm it daily.
- [Self-Love Languages: How to Speak the 5 Love Languages to Yourself](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/self-love-and-the-5-love-languages): The 5 love languages aren't only for partners. Here's how to speak each one to yourself, from kind words to self-soothing touch, and why it calms you.
- [Revenge Bedtime Procrastination: Why You Stay Up Late When You're Exhausted](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/sleep-procrastination): Staying up late scrolling to finally get time to yourself has a name: revenge bedtime procrastination. Here's why it happens and how to reclaim your evenings.
- [The Benefits of a Morning Stretch, and Why I Do Mine in the Sunshine](https://www.thebeyondhumanmethod.com/blog/sunrise-stretch): A few minutes of stretching in the morning light wakes up your circulation, lowers stress and sets your body clock. Here's a simple sunrise stretch routine.
